How do I log water?

On Today, tap a small, medium, or large glass for a quick entry. Tap DRINK to enter another amount. The displayed size follows your unit choice in Settings.

How do I correct an entry?

Open History, choose the day, and tap the trash button beside the incorrect entry. Then log the correct amount.

Why is my history not syncing?

Open Profile → Account to check iCloud availability. Confirm that both devices use the same Apple Account, iCloud is enabled, and each device has a network connection. Sync may take time; reopen the app after reconnecting.

How do I change my goal or reminders?

Open Profile → Daily Goal or Reminders. You can also change ounces and milliliters in Settings. Notification permission can be changed in iPhone Settings.

How do I remove my data?

Delete entries individually in History or reset hydration history in Settings. To remove your WaterBro profile and all entries together, open Profile → Account → Delete account and hydration history.

Can I use WaterBro offline?

Yes. Entries and your profile save on this device without a connection. Private iCloud syncing catches up when available. Sharing to an installed app may work offline, but posting requires the destination app and a connection.

How does the three-day preview work?

Every feature is available for the first three days. The preview ends without an automatic charge. A one-time lifetime purchase unlocks continued use. Open Premium to buy or restore a previous purchase.

Is WaterBro medical advice?

No. WaterBro is a general wellness tracker, not a medical device. Follow a qualified clinician’s guidance if you have symptoms, a health condition, or a fluid restriction.
